_comment: JetStream stream table from specs/21-bus-and-contracts.md §5. Single source of truth embedded by crates/fa-bus (streams.rs) and go/pkg/bus (streams.go); both sides test against it. JOBS_<kind> work queues are not listed: their owners create them (ensure_work_queue / EnsureWorkQueue) with the work_queue consumer tunables below. max_mib caps every stream (spec 21 §10.1 disk budget, sized from live `nats stream info` 2026-11-11 with >= 2x headroom); ensure never lowers a cap below a stream's current bytes.

streams.name: MD
streams.description: market data: live + short replay; long history in VictoriaMetrics/Garage

streams.name: MEDIA
streams.description: media chunk refs; blobs live in Garage

streams.name: LATENT
streams.description: latent states, regions, transitions and decoder outputs

streams.name: ORDERS
streams.description: order intents/events and risk state; ledger is source of truth, stream is audit aid

streams.name: DLQ
streams.description: dead letters: dlq.<stream>.<subject> copies of messages that hit max_deliver or were terminated (spec 21 §8)
